Launch geometries the selected runtime gives for a channels × samples buffer

```text
dspk inspect [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

- **`-c, --channels <CHANNELS>`**: default `384`  
  Channels of the buffer
- **`-s, --samples <SAMPLES>`**: default `30000`  
  Samples per channel
